title: Validate the complete text registry reader domain
changes: Compare both original text-registry reader prefixes for every byte index and its 0x100 alias, with interpreter and generated instruction dispatch and all table backing bytes inverted.
validation: Windows GNU build text-registry-complete-domain-build-mgpb_l51 and Wine text-registry-complete-domain-wine-u43_buss pass 2048 complete-state and guest-clock comparisons. Every selected four-byte word is served exactly once from typed resources; the trace drops no requests. Input guards pass, Wine drains and successful scratch is removed.
limitations: The prefixes stop before callback invocation. Conditional indices do not establish ordinary reachability or callback safety; generated blocks may fall back to interpretation. Other consumers, native Windows, Linux, USA and performance remain open.

The initial build launch rdk_ywcu used an invalid relative script path, and Wine launch bi3m_6lq could not access its runtime directory in the sandbox. Both ended before executing the test; the succeeding run used the absolute path and host Wine access.
